# File `sync-submodules`

Materialize the recursive submodule state recorded by the current tree.

Gitlink commits and .gitmodules URLs are versioned independently. Syncing the URL configuration before updating commits handles both kinds of change while moving through history. The update intentionally omits `--force`: local edits inside a submodule cause a visible failure instead of being overwritten.
